About the Project

ACTA FRAGILIA is an independent platform for long-form journalism, document analysis, and investigations in the fields of law, economics, corporate conflicts, and social processes.

No advertising, no news feed, no noise. Only verifiable facts, context, and an attempt to understand how legal, economic, and social processes work — and who bears their consequences.

Methodology

Each material is built on primary sources: court decisions, legislative acts, financial reports, and interviews with participants. We do not publish breaking news — only what can be verified and commented on in context.

Rubrics

  • Law — Analysis of legislation, judicial practice, and legal conflicts.
  • Economics — Analysis of corporate conflicts, bankruptcies, tax, and financial mechanisms.
  • Society — Social processes, institutions, and their transformation.
  • Media — Information flows, journalism, and media literacy.
  • Conflict — Corporate and economic disputes in detail.
  • Document — Analysis of one specific document with comments.

Principles

  1. Verifiability. Every fact can be traced to its source.
  2. Context. An event without context is not information, but noise.
  3. Consequences. Not only what happened matters, but also what follows.
  4. Independence. No advertising, no sponsors influencing editorial policy.

Author

The project is led by Kliment Vileysky. Contact: acta_fragilia@proton.me

Status

Independent project. Not a legal entity. Publications do not constitute legal advice.

License

Updates
